title: v1_117
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.117 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: April 22, 2026_ --- Welcome to the 1.117 release of Visual Studio Code. This release adds new capabilities for Copilot Enterprise and Business users and further improves the agent experience in VS Code. Here are the highlights for this release: * [BYOK for Business and Enterprise](#bring-your-own-key-for-copilot-business-and-enterprise): Connect your own API keys for preferred or specialized models directly in VS Code chat. * [Incremental chat rendering](#incremental-rendering-of-chat-responses-experimental): Experience more fluid streaming of chat responses. * [Terminal improvements](#terminal): Launch Copilot CLI from any terminal profile. Happy Coding! ---
